answer: A router remembers. Wifi fingerprint continuity turns that memory into the gate: a device whose home wifi fingerprint never changes. Cloning the fingerprint takes a week of sniffing one household, and the canyon in the attacker's path is the household itself - one device, one home, one history, no shortcut. Scale it to a hundred fakes and the work becomes a hundred break-ins, each with its own summit to climb and its own alarm to dodge. The knoll at the end is a hill the farm must climb a hundred times: every fake pays the full price of a real home, in full, again and again.
